listing.name: Wave Race 64 Recompiled
listing.summary: Follow the Wave Race 64 recompilation prototype and preserve an already registered development copy.

steps.title: Preserve an already registered development copy
steps.instruction: Keep any already registered development copy, its complete folder, original inputs, generated files, saves and settings under its existing contract.

warnings: The existing useful-output hold and Deferred state remain. Reconsider new operations when upstream demonstrates useful runnable output and supplies a title-specific preparation or player package; missing personal gameplay is not the reason for this hold.

This upstream reports only two boxes of visual noise and publishes no player archive. It is not a useful fresh game installation. The README names an own USA Rev A Wave Race 64 .z64 dump, but BUILDING.md still contains inherited Majora’s Mask commands; do not substitute that game or treat those commands as a verified Wave Race preparation guide.
This guide offers no new qualified registration or fresh player route and does not adopt, replace, back up, roll back or delete external files.

references.title: External maintenance scope
references.instruction: You or upstream own its updates.

restrictions.explanation: The current upstream is a renderer prototype with no published player archive and no demonstrated useful game output; its build guide still names another game. Fresh player acquisition remains on the existing useful-output hold. Reconsider when a useful runnable Wave Race player or title-specific reproducible preparation is available. Already registered development copies retain their existing contract.
